subject: how agents use truecap
preheader: send a branded analysis. close more investor clients.
headline: Agents who run numbers in front of investor clients win the listing.
body: If you're an agent working with investor clients, the moment of truth isn't the showing. It's the email after the showing. Your client asks 'does the deal pencil?' and they're testing whether you know.
Most agents send a vague answer back. 'Looks like a 7% cap, should cash flow nicely.' That's not an analysis. Sophisticated investors hear that and quietly move to a different agent.

The agents winning investor business are sending a one-page underwriting summary back within an hour. Cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, 10-year projection, and a real verdict. Branded with their logo and contact info. PDF attached. Looks like they hired an analyst.

TrueCap Pro generates that PDF. Paste an address, get the analysis, export to PDF with your branding, send to client. The whole loop takes about three minutes. Compared to what a real estate analyst costs ($300-1,000 per report), it's a freebie.
If you close one extra investor client per year because you looked sharper than the next agent, the $300/yr is the lowest-ROI line item in your business.
